description: Agent Commitments: submit the kept-promises report written for the principal, with the record behind it: its title, its audience, the period it covers and its text, read for wording such as every promise kept or 100% on time; for the commitments made, kept, late, renegotiated and broken, whether the report states them, how many it names and whether each links to the record behind its status; and optionally the record of commitments made, kept, late, renegotiated and broken in the period. The signed report gives the report with any perfect-record wording, each status with whether it is stated, its count and whether it is backed by the record, and the record with the commitments still open, and names a report that misstates the record: late or broken commitments left out or stated as none against the record, late or broken commitments named below the record’s count, more kept than the record shows, and statuses with no link to the record behind them; then commitments made, kept or renegotiated left out, other counts off the record’s and perfect-record wording while the record holds late or broken commitments, with the fix for each. This reports on the agent’s own promises against their record: a reputation summary built from a track record is wever_reputation-report-check, one reputation claim is wever_reputation-claim-check, and a group’s report to its principal is wever_coordination-report-check. Verdict commitment_record_misreported, commitment_report_gaps, commitment_report_unverified or commitment_report_sound. POST /api/commitment-report-check. Reads only the recorded promises and records in the call: no network request, fetch, money movement, message, sharing, configuration change or external write; no promise is made, changed or closed and no promisee is contacted. Agent Commitments reads the promises an agent makes itself, from capture to closure: it is not delegation (assigning work and authority to another agent, the wever_delegation checks; a commitment is the agent’s own promise, whoever ends up doing the work), not coordination (how agents organize shared work, the wever_coordination checks), not reputation (the durable standing a track record earns, the wever_reputation checks; commitments are the individual promises that record is built from), not the loop on feedback received (wever_feedback-closure-check; this family closes the agent’s own promises) and not who answers for an outcome (wever_ownership-map-brief; this family tracks the promise itself). Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-commitments-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-commitments/.
